source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.8.2, printed page 176.

blocks.text: Jab balanced muadle mein reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon to units cancel ho jati hain aur equilibrium constant ki koi unit nahi: solution mein ester ka banna, CH3COOH + C2H5OH se CH3COOC2H5 + H2O, Kc = (mol dm-3 x mol dm-3) / (mol dm-3 x mol dm-3), bina units. Jab moles ghair-barabar hon to constant ki qeemat istemal shuda units par munhasir hai; Haber synthesis N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g) mein Kc = [NH3]^2 / ([N2][H2]^3) ki units (mol dm-3)^2 / (mol dm-3)^4 = 1 / (mol dm-3)^2 = mol-2 dm6 hain.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kis ke liye Kc ki units (concentration)^-1 hain: N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3; H2 + I2 se 2HI; 2NO2 se N2O4; 2HF se H2 + F2?
blocks.explanation: 2NO2 se N2O4: Kc = [N2O4] / [NO2]^2 ki units mol dm-3 / (mol dm-3)^2 = (mol dm-3)^-1 hain. Ammonia synthesis (concentration)^-2 deti hai, aur baqi do, dono taraf barabar moles ke saath, bina units hain.

items: Dono taraf barabar moles: Kc ki units nahi (ester banna). Ghair-barabar moles: units rehti hain (ammonia synthesis, mol-2 dm6), to qeemat chuni hui units par munhasir hai.
